# pidginhost_kubernetes_cluster_server (Resource)

Connects a cloud server to the private network of a Kubernetes cluster. Connecting or disconnecting reboots the server. The server must be active, and the cluster must have cloud VM access enabled in the control panel; the API cannot read that setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Connecting the server reboots it. The cluster needs cloud VM access enabled
# in the control panel.
resource "pidginhost_kubernetes_cluster_server" "db" {
  cluster_id = pidginhost_kubernetes_cluster.example.id
  server_id  = "12"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) ID of the Kubernetes cluster. Changing it replaces the object.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the cloud server. Changing it replaces the connection, rebooting both servers.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) Host name of the server.
- `id` (String) <cluster_id>/<server_id>.
- `ip` (String) Address of the server in the cluster private network.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a connected server as <cluster_id>/<server_id>.
terraform import pidginhost_kubernetes_cluster_server.db 7/12
```
